/.title: ElderOps | Senior Engineering, Embedded in Your Team
/.description: ElderOps embeds senior DevOps, cloud, platform, and security engineers into your team to modernize systems, raise reliability, and cut risk, then hands off a system your team runs without us.

/services.title: Services | ElderOps
/services.description: Eight capabilities, one embedded team: cloud and infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps and delivery, security and DevSecOps, reliability, FinOps, data and modernization, and technology advisory.

/how-we-work.title: How We Work | ElderOps
/how-we-work.description: Assess. Build. Hand off. A named method and three stage-agnostic engagement models: fractional advisory, embedded delivery, and launch (0 to 1). We build inside your team, not around it.

/about.title: About | ElderOps
/about.description: The best engineering outcomes come from accountability, not headcount. A third path between consulting and staffing: senior engineers who embed with your team and see the work through.

/careers.title: Careers | ElderOps
/careers.description: Own the work. Set the terms. ElderOps is where senior engineers do embedded, high-trust work on engagements that fit their lives.

/contact-us.title: Contact | ElderOps
/contact-us.description: Tell us what you're building and where it is stuck. You'll talk to a senior engineer, not a sales team. Typical response within one business day.
